title: European Commission consults on draft guidance and template for reporting serious AI incidents
summary: On 26 September 2025 the European Commission published draft guidance on Article 73 of the AI Act, under which providers of high-risk AI systems must report serious incidents to national authorities, together with a draft reporting template, and opened a stakeholder consultation that closed on 7 November 2025. The guidance clarifies definitions, offers practical examples and explains how the reporting duty relates to other legal obligations; the rules become applicable from August 2026.
